Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 32: the slip of [[Beru Stew (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“USED: Activate 1 Force (2 if a Lars on table). OR During battle at a farm, add the destiny number of your device on this farm to your total power. LOST: During battle at a farm, after battle destiny is drawn, place a 'crop' out of play to make attrition against you = 0.”), word for word the text of [[Beru Stew (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
